name: TracepackForFreescout
description: Unofficial, community-built integration. Not affiliated with or endorsed by FreeScout. Adds a "Send to Tracepack for FreeScout" button to each conversation. Builds a tracepack-evidence v1 payload server-side from the conversation's thread and attachments, then hands it to the agent's browser to forward directly to the customer's own Tracepack tab via postMessage. No Tracepack account, no server-to-server call, and no data leaves the agent's own browser except the handoff the agent explicitly triggers.
